description: Refactor step M11a, class A (docs/plans/codebase-refactor.md §6.5): internal/mcp's API client, its JSON-RPC stdio server and the helpers the tool table builds on leave tools.go for client.go, stdio.go and schema.go, before splittools (specs/M11a.json there) splits Tools() itself in the class B commit. The helpers are the input schema builders, the argument readers and the response decoders, which sit together between ReadOnlyToolNames and Tools(). The free-floating comment that opens the stdio server in tools.go becomes stdio.go's header; declmove does not move a free-floating comment, so the commit deletes it from tools.go. Preview with: go run ./internal/tools/declmove -n -spec internal/tools/declmove/specs/M11a.json
